name: d3: Decision 3.0 live demo
description: Live demo of d3 on the free Decision API

paragraphs: A live demo of d3, one of the Decision 3.0 models of vLLM Semantic Router. The official Space is vllm-sr/Decision-3.0. Ask Choice, Yes / No and Score questions about text, images and video and read the probability of every answer. On d3 and d3-flash, Box questions find something in an image: one box and its confidence, grid-scored (65 yes / no sub-questions on a zooming grid). Compare the two models side by side, with their latency. Every run, the examples included, is a live request to the free Decision API at decision.vllm-sr.ai: nothing is precomputed.
